headline: Congress named a post office in Salem, Ohio after Howard Arthur Tibbs.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 275 Penn Avenue in Salem, Ohio, as the Howard Arthur Tibbs Post Office. It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates or its services. The official summary describes only the designation.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022.
